values./system/description:
A pre-War weapon found across the wastelands and used in large numbers by various aggressive factions. Combat Rifles are a rugged and adaptable design, able to be modified to fill a variety of different battlefield roles.

A Combat Rifle can accept one each of the following mods:

  • Receiver: Calibrated, Hardened, Automatic, Hair Trigger, Powerful, Advanced, .38 Receiver, .308 Receiver.
  • Barrel: Long Barrel, Ported Barrel, Vented Barrel
  • Stock: Full Stock, Marksman’s Stock, RecoilCompensating Stock
  • Magazine: Large Magazine, Quick-Eject Magazine, Large Quick-Eject Magazine
  • Sights: Reflex Sight, Short Scope, Long Scope, Short Night Vision Scope, Long Night Vision Scope, Recon Scope
  • Muzzle: Bayonet, Compensator, Suppressor
